title: Per-chunk latency histograms, span linking, and streaming redaction hooks
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Current streaming telemetry provides coarse request-level metrics and sparse traces which make it hard to diagnose per-chunk latency spikes, attribute downstream tool/function calls to the correct stream chunk, and safely store streamed outputs in logs. Goal: Add lightweight per-chunk metrics (latency histograms, byte counts, token deltas), deterministic span linking from chunk -> request -> route, and pluggable redaction hooks that run in the proxy/runtime to strip PII from streamed chunks before they hit storage or long-lived traces. Non-goals: full content-classification redaction ML model or client-side enforced redaction. Acceptance criteria: 1) Per-chunk latency histograms available in Console and exportable to prometheus/ingest with 50ms resolution; 2) Tracing shows chunk span ids linked to parent request span and to any tool/function call spans; 3) Redaction hooks API implemented with two built-in filters (email/SSN regex and token-blocklist) and a documented interface for custom functions; 4) No end-to-end latency regression >3% for p95 on standard streaming benchmark; 5) Tests and a migration doc for existing dashboards. Implementation notes: - Add a lightweight chunk sdk that emits metrics at chunk close (or flush) with labels: model, route, tenant, chunk_index, chunk_tokens. - Instrument runtime to create a chunk span nested under the request span; add attributes for start_offset, end_offset, bytes, tokens, and redaction_status. - Provide opt-in telemetry flag per-tenant to enable per-chunk detail to control cardinality and cost. - Redaction hook runs synchronously in the runtime path but must be bounded to 5ms total; hook runs before chunk is forwarded to logs/trace exporter. - Compatibility: maintain existing request-level metrics for consumers that do not opt-in. Testing plan: unit tests for metrics emission and redaction; integration test with trace sampler enabled; benchmark job (perf/streaming) to validate no >3% p95 regression. Rollout: feature flag behind tenant-level opt-in, start with internal tenants and PSC testbed, then staged enablement for 10 customers, monitor cost and cardinality for 2 weeks, then general availability. Rollback criteria: sustained >10% p95 latency regression or >2x increase in ingested metric cardinality beyond expected.
